items.prompt: Dewi's laptop has the IP address 169.254.12.7. What does it mean?
choices: The laptop failed to get an address from the router (DHCP failed)
items.explanation: A 169.254.x.x address appears when the computer doesn't get an IP address from the router. Check the cable, Wi-Fi, and router.

items.prompt: Put the network checks in order, from nearest to farthest.
steps: Check the cable is plugged in or Wi-Fi is on
Check the IP address it got
Ping an IP address on the internet
items.explanation: Check from your own device outward to the internet. That way you know at which point the path breaks.

items.prompt: Tap the ping results that show the problem is in DNS.

parts.text: Network cable plugged in, port light on.

items.explanation: An internet IP address can be pinged, but the site name isn't recognized. So the internet is connected and DNS is the problem.

items.prompt: Every computer on the 3rd floor of Nusa Digital loses internet at the same time. What is the decision?
choices: Escalate to the network team, because the problem is in the central network
Replace the cable at every desk one by one
Replace the Wi-Fi card in every laptop
items.explanation: When a whole floor drops at once, the cause isn't each person's device. Hand it to the network team.

items.prompt: What is the job of DNS?
choices: Giving the computer an IP address
Translating site names into IP addresses
items.explanation: DNS is like a phone book that looks up the IP address of a site name. The router's DHCP is what gives computers their IP address.
